listing.name: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (iortcw)
listing.summary: Windows prepared-player route: use the iortcw1.51c x64 single-player client with your own correctly prepared RTCW Main and applicable patch/locale data. Preserve actual base/home/game roots. Core offers nonowning registration/Play; upstream owns setup/replacement. Multiplayer, original assets and save compatibility remain separate.

steps.title: Choose the single-player native client
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted complete iortcw1.51c Windows x64 package with matching game/renderer libraries. Select iowolfsp.x64.exe: the selected Windows producer uses the x64 suffix. Do not substitute original WolfSP, the dedicated server, another architecture or the separate multiplayer client. Its native SP main owns the normal frame loop.

steps.title: Prepare your own complete RTCW data upstream
steps.instruction: Finish upstream single-player setup with your own supported RTCW Main data, including pak0.pk3 and applicable sp_pak1/sp_pak2/sp_pak3 and patch-data-141/locale files. Use the upstream instructions matching the actual edition/language; keep compatible code/data together in a separate recoverable working copy. Multiplayer requires its own data/code and is outside this SP route. Core neither downloads patches nor imports/authenticates original PK3s or runs a setup script.

steps.title: Keep actual launch and profile coordinates
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared working directory and same supported literal arguments. Preserve established fs_basepath/fs_homepath/fs_game choices and absolute custom roots as actually configured. Review exact intent/consent, then choose Play separately. Do not override the host profile root or force an unrelated empty profile to attach the player.

steps.title: Preserve complete external state
steps.instruction: Default Windows home data follows the actual Documents/RTCW known-folder location; configured roots and Main/game subdirectories may differ. Preserve the whole runtime and original data plus actual configs/profiles/saves/screenshots/demos/mods/unknown files in every base/home/game/custom/legacy root. Keep the old creating tuple before any upstream replacement. GPL engine and additional SP/component terms do not license the original game; no multiplayer, mod, or cross-version save compatibility follows from this registration.

steps.title: Keep replacement and removal ownership clear
steps.instruction: Close all real instances before external file changes. Upstream/player owns preparation, runtime replacement, profile writes and any migration/recovery. Preserve the old creating copy and every actual data root, finish deliberate replacement upstream and review/relink the changed player before the next Play. Core observes only its separately consented selected process, not an exclusive instance family or sandbox, and does not adopt unrelated helpers/successors. Registration-only removal preserves all external files. No Core-managed acquisition/setup/update/backup/rollback/migration/deletion is offered by this route.

warnings: This guide adds no Supported promotion, original/component permission, acquired-source-to-binary or private-output certificate. Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use.
Source/API and inert native probes are distinct from actual game/save/mod/network, installed Desktop, physical/human, other-platform or protected acceptance. No such new observation is claimed.
Keep complete actual external runtime and player-data roots recoverable before upstream changes; another player folder does not guarantee independent shared state.
